title: Trade Ideas Holly Assistant vs TrendSpider Sidekick — same prompt, very different result
author: Real_Box343
selftext:
I work with Trade Ideas and wanted to share a quick side-by-side we put together comparing our new Holly AI Assistant with TrendSpider’s Sidekick.

We gave both the same trading request and recorded what happened. Thought this group might find the difference in how each AI actually handles the request pretty interesting.

Curious what you guys think?

comments.author: JayDeKayZ
comments.body:
To be fair, you asked Holly to search all stocks and Sidekick just the S&P 500. Obviously you'd get more results with Holly. 

I've actually never heard of Holly and currently DO use Trendspider/Sidekick. Your example does show Sidekick's lag (which is real) but I'm curious as to what Holly is capable of?

It can be frustrating when using Sidekick having to direct it to search specific watchlists or lists before it searches, however I can also prompt it to 'show me any stock in my 'CORE' watchlist where the last 5 minute candle closed above or below the opening 20 minute range' or 'show me a list of stocks in my 'CORE' watchlist where the 8ma has crossed the 21ma today'

If Holly can match that and eliminate Sidekick's lag I'd for sure consider switching
